general: Only when the source shows the white STRIDE wordmark at the top centre over the blue-grey background, keep it centred with its top edge at about 5% of the canvas height and a width of about 28% of the canvas width; otherwise keep the source structure.

Only when the source shows a centred white headline above a smaller sub-line and price, keep that vertical stack centred in the upper third with the headline at about 82% of the canvas width; otherwise keep the source structure.

Only when the source shows a single orange shoe floating in the centre, keep it centred at about 55% of the canvas width above the floor shadow and let extra height or width go to the blue-grey background and floor, which are the flexible elements; otherwise keep the source structure.

Only when the source shows a single rounded-rectangle CTA button at the bottom centre, keep it centred at about 34% of the canvas width and 6% of the canvas height with its bottom edge at about 8% of the canvas height; otherwise keep the source structure.

Only when the source uses the blue-grey gradient background and grey floor, keep text and the wordmark in #ffffff, the product colour as shown in #ff6a1a, and the CTA fill in #5f7d93 tones without recolouring fixed elements; otherwise keep the source structure.
never: Never add extra logos or wordmarks beyond the single STRIDE wordmark shown in the source.
Never add extra buttons, badges, tabs, bands, panels, or frames not shown in the source.
Never add extra products, shoes, people, or props not shown in the source.
Never add extra headlines, price lines, or promotional text not shown in the source.
text: English Latin script only, with all headline, sub-line, price, and CTA text centre-aligned as shown.
STRIDE wordmark is uppercase, bold, and italic in white, smaller than the headline.
Headline is bold white and about twice the height of the sub-line and price lines, which are regular weight and similar in size to each other.
CTA text is regular white sentence case centred inside the single rounded button.
